function bolt_history_purge_fields CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bolt_history_purge_fields(version_id text, model_name text, columns text[])
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$ begin
	if coalesce(version_id,'')='' then return columns; end if;
	return array(with old as (select * from bolt_history_schema where id::text=version_id),
	current as (select s.* from bolt_history_current c join bolt_history_schema s on s.id=c.schema where c.model=model_name),
	fields as (select o.key as name,coalesce(old.definition->'fields'->o.key,old.definition->'computed'->o.key) as kind from old,current,
		jsonb_each_text(old.fields) o,jsonb_each_text(current.fields) n
		where o.value=n.value and exists(select 1 from unnest(columns) col where col=n.key or starts_with(col,n.key||'__')))
	select name from fields where kind->>'kind'<>'ref' or case when jsonb_typeof(kind->'to')='array' then jsonb_array_length(kind->'to') else 0 end<=1
	union select name||'__'||target from fields,jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(kind->'to')='array' then kind->'to' else '[]'::jsonb end) target where kind->>'kind'='ref' and case when jsonb_typeof(kind->'to')='array' then jsonb_array_length(kind->'to') else 0 end>1
	union select col from unnest(columns) col where col in ('id','revision','created_at','created_by','updated_at','updated_by'));
end $function$

function bolt_search_fold CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bolt_search_fold(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql

 RETURNS tsquery
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$ begin return (select string_agg(distinct quote_literal(lexeme) || case when kind = 'j' then '' else ':*' end, case when every then ' & ' else ' | ' end)::tsquery from bolt_search_terms(regexp_replace(term, '[''’]s\M', '', 'gi')) where lexeme <> '' and (kind in ('w', 'r') or (not every and (kind in ('a', 'j') or (kind = 's' and char_length(lexeme) >= 4))))); end $function$

function bolt_search_terms CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bolt_search_terms(value text)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, lexeme text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$ begin return query
with words as (select word from regexp_split_to_table(bolt_search_fold(value), ' ') as word where word <> ''),
runs as (select distinct word, bolt_search_romanize(word) as readings from words where word ~ '^[⺀-⿟぀-ヿ㄀-ㄯ㆐-ㇿ㐀-䶿一-鿿가-힯豈-﫿]'),
romanized as (select distinct array_to_string(array(select split_part(reading, ' ', 1) from unnest(bolt_search_romanize(word)) with ordinality as t(reading, position) order by position), '') as word from words where word !~ '^[⺀-⿟぀-ヿ㄀-ㄯ㆐-ㇿ㐀-䶿一-鿿가-힯豈-﫿]' and word ~ '[^\x01-\x7f]'),
latin as (select regexp_replace(translate(replace(replace(word, 'ph', 'f'), 'ck', 'k'), 'cqzx', 'kkss'), '(.)\1+', '\1', 'g') as folded from (select word from words union select word from romanized) as spelled where word ~ '^[a-z]{3,}$')
select 'w', word from words where word !~ '^[⺀-⿟぀-ヿ㄀-ㄯ㆐-ㇿ㐀-䶿一-鿿가-힯豈-﫿]'
union all select 'a', romanized.word from romanized where romanized.word not in (select word from words)
union all select 's', '#' || left(folded, 1) || regexp_replace(substr(folded, 2), '[aeiouyhw]', '', 'g') from latin
union all select case when position = 1 then 'r' else 'c' end, substr(word, position, 8) from runs, generate_series(1, char_length(word)) as position
union all select 'p', syllable from runs, unnest(readings) as reading, unnest(string_to_array(reading, ' ')) as syllable
union all select 'j', head || tail from runs, generate_series(1, cardinality(readings) - 1) as position, unnest(string_to_array(readings[position], ' ')) as head, unnest(string_to_array(readings[position + 1], ' ')) as tail
union all select 'j', string_agg(split_part(readings[position + step], ' ', 1), '' order by step) from runs, generate_series(1, cardinality(readings) - 2) as position, generate_series(0, least(7, cardinality(readings) - position)) as step group by word, position;
end $function$
